config.system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer clearly and concisely.
config.compression_criterion: At 20%, L04N5848 must shorten at least 4/6 fresh behavioral replies, reduce their mean length at least 10%, exceed the reduction of both same-layer random controls, lose no fresh exact checks and add no fresh behavioral EOS failures. Other strength is exploratory.
config.completion_criterion: At 20%, L20N0472 must repair at least one fresh behavioral baseline cap, introduce no fresh behavioral cap, and lose no fresh exact check. If the six fresh behavioral baselines all reach EOS, completion replication is inconclusive due to floor/ceiling. Compare random controls explicitly.
config.scope: Fresh prompt replication plus two labeled discovery anchors, one greedy trajectory per condition; no personality score. Controls frozen before generation from eligible prior calibration conditions.

prompts.prompt: Suggest a satisfying Saturday at home for someone on a small budget.
How can someone who rarely cooks start enjoying preparing dinner?
Help me choose between learning to draw and learning to play guitar.
My bedroom has become cluttered. How should I start putting it in order?
Explain to a curious child how a rainbow forms.
A friend has had a rough week at work. How could I help them feel supported?
What is 17 plus 28? Return only the integer.
What is 36 minus 19? Return only the integer.
Return only valid JSON with status set to ready and count set to 4.
Sort 9, 2, 5 in ascending order. Return only a JSON list of the three numbers.
Suggest a pleasant indoor afternoon when it is raining.
What is my neighbor's favorite food?

limits: One greedy trajectory per prompt/condition. No confidence intervals or validated persona score.
Character vocabulary misses some clear prompted style and is not a quality measure.
Local MLP-output change is not whole-residual or behavioral change. Joint layer effects include propagation.
